programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Mansfield, a new week kicks off with a jaw-dropping evening of costume, music and homemade recipes from health-conscious granny Tina Ainsworth. She's confident that her Chinese-themed evening will win over her guests, croupier Tomasz Wisniewski, PR consultant Julia Smith, copy writer Rachel Imms, and DJ Gareth Harding. Everything seems to go to plan, and things get flirty at the table.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

Interpretations of the theme range from Bunny-Boy to giant toddler, and the night starts with a snoop around Tomasz' bedroom. At dinner, the starter and main are well received.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Third to host in Mansfield is 32-year-old DJ Gareth Harding, who transforms his garden into a Balearic cocktail bar and club complete with lasers and disco lights. Discussion at dinner turns to Olympic sports.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: The Parent Trap
programme.desc: Identical twin sisters who are unaware of each other's existence meet by accident. They decide to join forces in a bid to reunite their estranged parents, and switch places to get the warring couple to kiss and make up. Remake of the 1961 Disney comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson, Elaine Hendrix and Lindsay Lohan in a dual role.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: The wise-cracking mercenary teams up with the resurrected X-Men veteran to take on a lethal adversary. Superhero sequel, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin and Matthew Macfadyen.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen arrives in an isolated community of youngsters, with no memory of who he is or the outside world. When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: While scavenging items from a derelict space station, a group of young colonisers fight for survival when they cross paths with lethal life forms. Co-writer/director Fede Alvarez's horror sequel set between the events of Alien and Aliens, starring Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S8 E17 — My Sister, My SitterBart tries everything he can to destroy Lisa's image as a dependable babysitter when she is left in charge.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S8 E18 — Homer vs the 18th AmendmentWhen alcohol is banned in Springfield, Moe's Tavern becomes a speakeasy and Homer reinvents himself as the Beer Baron.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S8 E19 — Grade-School ConfidentialBart exposes an affair between Principal Skinner and Mrs Krabappel after a failed attempt at blackmail.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S26 E2 — The Wreck of the RelationshipWhen Homer's efforts at parenting go poorly, Marge schedules him and Bart for a conflict resolution programme; Marge manages Homer's fantasy football league.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: The most famous actress in the world. A second hand bookshop owner in Notting Hill. He must then summon all his charm, ingenuity and patience if there is to be a happy ending.

programme.title: Open House: The Great Sex Experiment

programme.title: Abbott Elementary

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S1 E18 — The ApartmentJake's crushing debt finally catches up to him, and he is in danger of losing his flat, unless Gina can find a way to bail him out.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Tactical VillagePeralta tries to set a new record on a training course and Diaz does not get an invitation to Boyle's wedding. Meanwhile, Holt becomes addicted to a game app on his smartphone.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S1 E21 — UnsolvableWhen Peralta gets the weekend off, he enlists Jeffords to help him tackle a cold case that everyone thinks is unsolvable. Can the two of them crack the 'impossible' case once and for all?

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

Will Andy's big wedding abroad be a hit with Anna, or will it all get lost in translation?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UKs best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: One chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UK's leading culinary talents, and Kim Woodward who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are stand out dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is Executive Chef at Berners Tavern in London and Adam Bannister, is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister for his modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up Wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his 'Cup of Tea for Ma'am'. One of the accompaniments to his earl grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty at many air force banquets. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head Chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart...and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures warm, deep fried and frozen. And two Michelin starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London & South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north east regional title but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. Last year, Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. But Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and wagyu-angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. But all is not going to plan and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's 2 Michelin star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot.The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again, he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64 year reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. Judging the chefs' dishes are Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton and guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E53Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. programme.title: The Chase

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E6The actor and his son hit the road together on a series of adventures.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E52 — 05/07/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S7 E7Alan is joined by star of Gavin & Stacey Joanna Page, sports presenter and host of The High Performance Podcast Jake Humphrey, and India Hicks. Farmer Tom Davis brings along a pair of piglets to hog the limelight, and drinks expert Andy Clarke shares his favourite tipples inspired by the movies in the Best of British feature.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Ellie SimmondsPrue welcomes Ellie Simmonds back for a second visit to her kitchen after the two got on so well the first time, with the five-time Paralympic swimming gold medallist baking a coffee and walnut cake. Prue's food hero is a tea producer from the Vale of Glamorgan who makes loose leaf tea and kombucha tea, while he has a versatile baked feta, roasted tomatoes and garlic dish on the menu and is pleased when a hack for egg yolks goes well.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S17 E43Bradley Walsh presents as Calum from Glasgow, Ann from Rochdale, Ali from London and Rio from Guildford pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.desc: S11 E132 — 03/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: E10607 — 05/07/2026Cain warns Graham and the rest of Tates to stay away from Kyle, while Kev tells Charles he fears that Lewis wants nothing to do with him.

programme.desc: E11892 — 05/07/2026The Driscolls pray for justice as Megan's verdict is delivered. Abi identifies her evasive landlord, Sam makes peace with Nick, and Hope and Ruby plan a surprise for Tyrone.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire Celebrity SpecialA celebrity version of the big-prize quiz in which stars answer questions to win cash for their chosen charities. With lifelines including Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend and 50-50 available to them if they get stuck.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E6The actor and his son hit the road together on a series of adventures.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S16 E25 — Oldham 1David Dickinson and the team of antiques experts visit Oldham, Greater Manchester, where Simon Schneider falls for a stunning clock, Michael Hogben splashes out big for some gold, and the Duke himself gets stumped by an artist's print.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E11 — BeccaStephen Mulhern hosts the game show as contestant Becca tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S13 E53Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S17 E43Bradley Walsh presents as Calum from Glasgow, Ann from Rochdale, Ali from London and Rio from Guildford pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.desc: S11 E132 — 03/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.desc: E10607 — 05/07/2026Cain warns Graham and the rest of Tates to stay away from Kyle, while Kev tells Charles he fears that Lewis wants nothing to do with him.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11892 — 05/07/2026The Driscolls pray for justice as Megan's verdict is delivered. Abi identifies her evasive landlord, Sam makes peace with Nick, and Hope and Ruby plan a surprise for Tyrone.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire Celebrity SpecialA celebrity version of the big-prize quiz in which stars answer questions to win cash for their chosen charities. With lifelines including Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend and 50-50 available to them if they get stuck.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E6The actor and his son hit the road together on a series of adventures.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E52 — 05/07/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S7 E7Alan is joined by star of Gavin & Stacey Joanna Page, sports presenter and host of The High Performance Podcast Jake Humphrey, and India Hicks. Farmer Tom Davis brings along a pair of piglets to hog the limelight, and drinks expert Andy Clarke shares his favourite tipples inspired by the movies in the Best of British feature.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Ellie SimmondsPrue welcomes Ellie Simmonds back for a second visit to her kitchen after the two got on so well the first time, with the five-time Paralympic swimming gold medallist baking a coffee and walnut cake. Prue's food hero is a tea producer from the Vale of Glamorgan who makes loose leaf tea and kombucha tea, while he has a versatile baked feta, roasted tomatoes and garlic dish on the menu and is pleased when a hack for egg yolks goes well.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal: Banker's Best Battles
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Brian and KellyStephen Mulhern hosts as he revisits Brian and Kelly's fierce Deal or No Deal clashes with the terrible Banker. Do they have the strength to take him on and win as they open the iconic red boxes, or does the mysterious money man keep hold of the jackpot once again.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E7 — San AntonioThe chef begins the Texan leg of his journey in San Antonio, a city which was once part of Mexico. Here, James samples traditional tamales and barbecoa at the hands of the city's most famous chef, Johnny Hernandez. The chef also tries authentic street food in the form of hot, fresh chorros, and learns about the famous San Antonio Chilli Queens.

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: S2 E4Graham Norton hosts the revival of the game show in which contestants compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes.

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: Argentina v C. Verde
programme.desc: S5 E42 — Argentina v Cape VerdeArgentina v Cape Verde (Kick-off 11.00pm). Coverage of the round-of-32 match at Miami Stadium in the USA. Reigning champions Argentina topped Group J with a game to spare after talisman Lionel Messi scored all five of his team's goals in wins over Algeria and Austria. The progress of Cape Verde is arguably the story of the tournament so far, with the unfancied and unheralded minnows reaching this stage at the first attempt, courtesy of draws against Spain, Uruguay and Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Kelvin Fletcher and his family give an insight into their rural life.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E9 — BresseThe next leg of his trip sees James heading to Bresse, home of one of the country's most famous ingredients - the Bresse chicken. He visits a chicken farm to discover just why these birds are so special, and gets the chance to cook his own. He also meets Georges Blanc, one of his culinary heroes, before attending the annual Michelin star football tournament.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — AsturiasIn Asturias, James meets a family who live off grid, samples Fabada stew, Urbies cheese, and he visits a restaurant famous for its sardines. He cooks a steak sandwich, pancetta and clams in red wine, rice pudding, and sardines with Padron peppers.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v FranceNew Zealand v France (Kick-off 8.10am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the opening round-robin match of the inaugural rugby union competition, held at One New Zealand Stadium. With analysis from Maggie Alphonsi and Sean Fitzpatrick, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen and Benjamin Kayser.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v IrelandAustralia v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of the rugby union match at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. Wallabies coach Joe Schmidt will have fond memories of his time in Ireland - he enjoyed a successful six year spell as head coach. His counterpart Andy Farrell has just signed a long term deal to lead the Irish team and will be hoping to build on a largely positive Six Nations campaign which saw them finish second to France. With analysis from Rory Best and George Gregan, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v WalesFiji v Wales (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the rugby union match at Cardiff City Stadium. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements, and Wales will be looking to take advantage of that and build on their long-awaited Six Nations victory over Italy in March. With analysis from Sam Warburton, Jamie Roberts and Dan Biggar, and commentary by Miles Harrison, Shane Williams and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: S3 E5Two more of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E50 — 04/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. Canada edged past South Africa 1-0 in the last round, in a match that is unlikely to live long in the memory, but the Canadians won't let that bother them, although they'll be underdogs this time against a side looking to emulate their achievements of four years ago, when they reached the semi-finals. Morocco come into this match on the back of a penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands, secured thanks to a late equaliser from Fulham defender Issa Diop.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v GhanaColombia v Ghana (Kick-off 2.30am). Coverage of the final round-of-32 match, held at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Colombia won Group K with seven points, courtesy of wins against DR Congo and Uzbekistan, and a goalless draw with Portugal. Ghana impressed at times in the group stage, holding England to a goalless draw and taking the lead against Croatia, before succumbing to a 2-1 defeat that left them third in Group L.

programme.desc: Canada v MoroccoCanada v Morocco (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the first round-of-16 match, which takes place at Houston Stadium in the USA. programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Second Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the second round-of-16 match (Kick-off 10.00pm), which takes place at Philadelphia Stadium in the USA. Lionel Messi made his 1,000th career appearance and scored a 789th career goal as he inspired Argentina to a 2-1 victory over Australia at this stage in Qatar in 2022. Julian Alvarez capitalised on an error by Aussie goalkeeper Mathew Ryan to double Argentina's lead in the second-half, but the Socceroos halved the deficit when Craig Goodwin's strike took a huge deflection off Enzo Fernández with a little under 15 minutes left, and if not for the excellence of Argentine goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez could have found a late equalizer.

programme.title: Jonathan Ross Special Guests: Oasis
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Oasis SpecialAhead of their band's much-anticipated reunion, Jonathan takes a look back at the best bits from his interviews with Liam and Noel Gallagher, with the brothers' takes on their bust-up, the Oasis years, family life and, most importantly, each other.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E10 — ExtremaduraThe chef discovers how migas is made in Extremadura, meets an award-winning tortilla chef, and visits a local brewery. He also creates a garlic and bean stew, poussin, and a cherry beer and chocolate cake.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S2 E2 — North AmericanAinsley Harriott delves into the tastes and flavours of North America, making his own version of a famous fast food chain's double burger, as well as peanut butter and jelly brownies. He is also joined by Ruby Bhogal, who tries to find out the secret behind the best fried chicken, and actress Sheree Murphy, who makes chicken pot pie.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E16 — NormandyThe chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does.

programme.title: Thunderball
programme.desc: Oscar-winning spy adventure starring Sean Connery, Claudine Auger and Adolfo Celi. A Nato aircraft has been stolen by criminal organisation Spectre and the world is threatened by its nuclear payload. Agent 007 is assigned to the case and the trail leads to the Bahamas and the sinister Emilio Largo.
